E1.calibration: not used; any future reselection requires independent calibration seeds
E1.detection_threshold: read final cfg.ekf_cusum_alarm_on_threshold per grid point
E1.pairing: actual noise, truth, range and GPS input signatures checked against same-seed center
E1.event_rules: reuse E3 closed intervals, separate threshold/alarm/admission onsets, preexisting/missed, 30s stable recovery and censor rules
E1.position: all followers, pooled, equal-follower macro; 0-600s, 30001 samples; Hazen CDF95; seed means and sample SD

E4.algorithm_specific: GPS correction where applicable, detection/weighting/admission, range update or graph building/solve/covariance, Kalman feedback; exclude offline sensor/truth generation
E4.end_to_end: sum of 50 Hz SINS computation within 1s plus complete 1Hz online update including common time update and priors; exclude offline simulation, reporting, plots and export
E4.summary: per-seed Mean,Median,P95,P99,Max,budget-exceedance; across seed mean and sample SD; seed is replicate
E4.verification: position/error and actual inputs equal to E2 matching seed
E4.scope: current hardware/MATLAB and 1Hz only; no airborne hard-real-time claim

E5.no_isolation: only stop excluding new factors; keep detector, alarm, predictor freeze and soft weights
E5.no_soft_weighting: only set admitted factor weights to 1; keep detector, alarm, freeze, isolation and recovery
E5.pairing: inputs and detector states must match A0; no variant-specific tuning
E5.statistics: all-follower, pooled, macro position metrics and paired seed differences

failure_policy: preserve failed attempts; no dropping seeds or zero-filling missing delays
